f1_qwen_only_6.why: Mistral-Large-2 is the only non-Qwen rung and the largest, so it is simultaneously the family change and the scale extreme. This refit removes it.

em_all.metric: exact match, 2023 minus 2026, recomputed from raw predictions

verdict.conditional_on_ladder: the slope is not quiz-sampling noise (CI [3.1389, 8.7312])
verdict.over_model_rungs: exact permutation p=0.008532 on n=7 with the leave-one-out slope keeping its sign across every rung
verdict.supported_claim: The boundary gap is positively associated with scale ACROSS THE SEVEN EVALUATED RUNGS. Both targets agree, so this is not an artifact of quiz sampling or of one rung. It is still an association in one ladder, not a capability effect: parameters, family, training corpus and cutoff all move together, and with n=7 the OLS interval is wide.
verdict.not_supported: any statement of the form 'more capable models have a larger knowledge cliff' as a general property of LLMs.
